_doc: D-Noir blood (lane noir): blood is THE colour of this direction. Units: px at 32 px/m world scale (1 m = 32 px), ticks at 60 Hz. spurt = the droplets thrown along the hit direction; each droplet that lands leaves a splat decal. pool = a slow-spreading pool under a kill. Decals persist and fade over fade_ticks after fade_after_ticks. Colours are the protected red the look_noir pass keeps (r high, g/r under 0.14). Splats are teardrops along the drop's travel with satellite drops ahead (blood_marks.gd); a pool is a wobbly wet edge run out along the hit (pool.run) with a bright red meniscus rim around the dark body and a white sheen arc. stain = blood ON the bodies (blood_stains.gd, drawn above the rigs, following each body): spots per hit kind, radius r_px, scattered spread_px around a point exit_px toward the exit side of the hit, growing over grow_ticks; max_stains is the pool. drip = a wounded fighter (player_hit) bleeds for bleed_ticks: one drop every every_px px moved (stretched along the move), one every still_ticks while standing. fluids = other fluids than blood (colour sets; flight = the colour of a droplet in the air, default the blood colour; case_px = an ink casing around each droplet in the air so white sparks read on paper too; trail = the fluid's own streak length, default physics.trail). player = what the player's body loses on player_hit: Rivet is a robot, so his hits throw white sparks that land as black oil (hit kind robot_hit, fluid oil) and leave no red: red is human blood only. An empty fluid = blood.

game.doc: lane d5-combat: the blood of the default D4/D5 game (features/fx/combat_blood.gd). default = the mode without -- --blood (noir = this blood, the D4 ink splat muted; ink = the D4 ink splat with the cream rim only, the fallback; both = the splat under the blood). replaces_fx = the fx.json kinds the blood replaces under noir. death_hit = the hits row a sim death sprays. ink_px / ink = the ink keyline around each pool (the D4/D5 print). kill_beat = the comic kill beat without -- --kill-beat (off|panel|flash|both; features/fx/kill_beat.gd). settled_redraw_ticks = the canvas redraw cadence while no droplet flies (the pools grow ~0.04 px a tick and the fade is minutes long; landed splats are on the GPU mesh and need no redraw). pool_dark = the pool body of the D4/D5 game (palette blood_dark #540005; the palette token wins once it lands); NOT under --look=noir: the noir pass's blood gate prints a body that dark as black, so noir keeps colour.blood_dark.

muzzle_pop.doc: lane d5-combat, features/fx/muzzle_pop.gd: a round fired lights the scene for one sim tick: a soft ADD pool of paper light radius_m wide at strength, at most one per lit_gap_ticks and only while the shared FlashBudget has a light to spend (none under reduced motion). on = false drops the node. near_m: only a round that close to the camera focus pops (the nearest of a tick wins).
